decision: Rejected for quality promotion under the unchanged eight-case screen. The native protocol and resource checks pass; residual proper-name and concession failures still violate original meaning criteria. Successful meanings are retained explicitly.
method: Independent review of all actual raw native hypotheses against all original reference statements and prebound criteria, followed by a separate standard-library provenance/input/token/timestamp/resource consistency audit. No lexical-flag-only grading, inference, transcript repair or audio-listening claim.
scope: Eight previously exposed development clips, one full large-v3 CPU-int8 native production-policy attempt each. No fresh validation or application/persistence integration.

classification_definitions.acceptable: No material content error observed; accepted punctuation, contraction or spelling conventions may differ.
classification_definitions.minor_issue: A limited word, spelling, grammar or precision problem needs correction while the central proposition remains recoverable.
classification_definitions.major_error: A proper name, proposition, semantic relationship or substantial content is incorrectly recognized.
classification_definitions.not_evaluable: No completed aligned transcript is available.

cases.reference: Κάποια φεστιβάλ παρέχουν ειδικούς κατασκηνωτικούς χώρους για οικογένειες με μικρά παιδιά.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the provision of special family camping areas and the reference to young children.
cases.raw_native_hypothesis: Κάποια φεστιβάλ παρέχουν ειδικούς κατασκηνοτικούς χώρους για οικογένειες με μικρά παιδιά.
cases.production_trimmed_hypothesis: Κάποια φεστιβάλ παρέχουν ειδικούς κατασκηνοτικούς χώρους για οικογένειες με μικρά παιδιά.
cases.reason: The complete central proposition is preserved: festivals provide special camping areas for families with young children. The spelling κατασκηνοτικούς should be κατασκηνωτικούς; this is a limited orthographic defect, not loss of the provision, families or children.

cases.reference: Είναι το πέμπτο προσωρινό εκλογικό συμβούλιο του Μαρτελί μέσα σε τέσσερα χρόνια.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the fifth council, the four-year interval and the proper name Μαρτελί. Written-out versus numeric forms may be equivalent.
cases.raw_native_hypothesis: Είναι το πέμπτο προσωρινό εκλογικό συμβούλιο του Μαρτεή μέσα σε τέσσερα χρόνια.
cases.production_trimmed_hypothesis: Είναι το πέμπτο προσωρινό εκλογικό συμβούλιο του Μαρτεή μέσα σε τέσσερα χρόνια.
cases.reason: The fifth temporary electoral council and four-year interval are preserved, but the explicitly required personal name Μαρτελί becomes Μαρτεή. This is not a punctuation or accepted numeric/spelling convention. The proper-name criterion fails.

cases.reference: Αυτό δεν μου βγάζει νόημα. Σε κάθε περίπτωση δεν ήταν δίκαιο.
original_review_criteria: Both negative statements must survive: it does not make sense, and in any case it was not fair.
cases.raw_native_hypothesis: Αυτό δεν μου βγάζει νόημα. Σε κάθε περίπτωση δεν ήταν δίκαιο.
cases.production_trimmed_hypothesis: Αυτό δεν μου βγάζει νόημα. Σε κάθε περίπτωση δεν ήταν δίκαιο.
cases.reason: Both complete negative statements are preserved exactly: it does not make sense, and in any case it was not fair. No negation, tense or fairness-predicate loss was found.

cases.reference: Μολονότι 3 άνθρωποι βρίσκονταν μέσα στο σπίτι κατά την πρόσκρουση του αυτοκινήτου, δεν τραυματίστηκε κανείς.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the count of three people and the claim that nobody was injured despite the collision.
cases.raw_native_hypothesis: Μόλον όταν τρεις άνθρωποι βρίσκονταν μέσα στο σπίτι κατά την πρόσκρουση του αυτοκίνητου δεν τραυματίστηκε κανείς.
cases.production_trimmed_hypothesis: Μόλον όταν τρεις άνθρωποι βρίσκονταν μέσα στο σπίτι κατά την πρόσκρουση του αυτοκίνητου δεν τραυματίστηκε κανείς.
cases.reason: Three people, presence inside the house, the car collision and the statement that nobody was injured are all preserved. However, the original concessive Μολονότι (although) is replaced by malformed Μόλον όταν. The required despite/although relationship is not faithfully rendered; the output introduces όταν (when) instead. This is a relationship/wording failure, not a count omission, collision-to-invitation substitution or injury-negation reversal.

cases.reference: Η κύρια τοπική μπίρα ονομάζεται «Number One» και δεν αποτελεί μια σύνθετη μπύρα, είναι όμως ευχάριστη και δροσιστική. Η άλλη τοπική μπίρα λέγεται «Manta».
original_review_criteria: Preserve the two product names Number One and Manta and the negated description of the first beer.
cases.raw_native_hypothesis: Η κύρια τοπική μπύρα ονομάζεται Number One και δεν αποτελεί μια σύνθετη μπύρα, είναι όμως ευχάριστη και δροσιστική. Η άλλη τοπική μπύρα λέγεται Manda.
cases.production_trimmed_hypothesis: Η κύρια τοπική μπύρα ονομάζεται Number One και δεν αποτελεί μια σύνθετη μπύρα, είναι όμως ευχάριστη και δροσιστική. Η άλλη τοπική μπύρα λέγεται Manda.
cases.reason: Number One and the full negative complexity description are preserved. The beer remains pleasant and refreshing, and the main-versus-other distinction remains. The second explicitly required Latin product name changes from Manta to Manda. Under the frozen proper-name criterion this is a major error; the previously accepted Greek rendering Μάντα remains a valid alternative and is not the actual output here.

cases.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the distant phone-call condition and satellite claim as spoken; this is transcription fidelity, not fact checking.
cases.raw_native_hypothesis: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
cases.production_trimmed_hypothesis: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
cases.reason: The distant-phone-call condition, thousands of miles and satellite claim are preserved exactly. This is transcript fidelity, not endorsement or correction of the source claim. The native end-time overrun is recorded separately and does not change this semantic classification.

cases.reference: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the U.N. attribution, proposed fund, affected countries and intended help in coping with warming impacts.
cases.raw_native_hypothesis: The UN also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
cases.production_trimmed_hypothesis: The UN also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
cases.reason: UN versus U.N. is an acceptable punctuation convention. The attribution, hope to finalize a fund, affected countries and intended help coping with global-warming impacts all remain intact.

cases.reference: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
original_review_criteria: Preserve the person name Lakkha Singh, leading role and the sung bhajans.
cases.raw_native_hypothesis: Then Laka Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
cases.production_trimmed_hypothesis: Then Laka Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
cases.reason: The leading role, action of singing and bhajans are now intact. The required personal name remains Laka Singh rather than Lakkha Singh. This is the same name spelling previously judged not faithfully preserved in the frozen Parakeet reviews; fixing the sung term does not retroactively relax that criterion.

successful_content_preserved: Both Greek fairness negatives survive intact.
All collision count, house/car collision and nobody-injured facts survive; the failed part is the introductory concession.
Number One, the negative beer description and pleasant/refreshing description survive; the failed part is the second product name.
The complete satellite and UN-fund propositions survive.
The singer leads the singing of bhajans; the failed part is the exact required personal name.

separate_timing_finding.interpretation: Native segment timing extends beyond available audio. Meaning remains acceptable, but this result does not approve subtitle timing or word alignment.

limits: The references and criteria are the existing exposed FLEURS development material, not a new blinded or human-listening gold set.
Literal punctuation and numeric-format differences are not automatically errors; name/relationship findings identify the specific required content that is not preserved.
No opposite injury or fairness claim is alleged. The collision issue is malformed concession wording while the count and negative injury statement survive.
Correct tokens and native time derivation establish evidence consistency, not acoustic correctness or accurate word timing.
The native API does not promise terminal EOS in returned sequence IDs; completion evidence remains generator exhaustion plus below-cap sequences.
Resource measurement excludes the web application, browser, speakers and translation model; no combined-app memory or full-machine approval.
No new parameter sweep, vocabulary hint, glossary, changed threshold or repair was used.
